# Interface texts

Every text the desktop interface says that is no command's and no error's: a line's sentence, a control's name, a word of the modeline. **A text that is not declared does not exist** — the interface shows one by a generated handle, so one that was removed is a compile error, and each is written in every locale (`§10.9`).

What a command is called, and what a refusal says, are their own registries': `docs/commands.md` and `docs/errors.md`.
